run.name: TripAdvisor, Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (TRIP)
run.summary: Tripadvisor has strong liquidity and no large maturity before 2031, but its earnings base is shrinking. Gross leverage is 4.02x, and the credit depends on Experiences replacing Hotels and Other earnings. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 833.9 at September 30, 2026 (Q3 10-Q page:62) over LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 207.3 (Q4 2025 43.4 plus nine months 2026 163.9); net of continuing cash 706.8 (Q3 10-Q page:3). Sale proceeds received November 1, 2026 are excluded. Deferred merchant payables of 396.8 sit against the cash; net of that float the ratio is 2.53x.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 207.3 over LTM cash interest of 59.2 (59 less nine months 2025 42.9 plus nine months 2026 43.1; Q3 10-Q page:7). Burdened by stock-based compensation add-back; after deducting LTM stock-based compensation of 70.2 the cover is 2.32x.

cash.basis: Cash. Continuing cash at September 30, 2026 (Q3 10-Q page:3) and printed available borrowing capacity of 497.7 (Q3 10-Q page:61). Deferred merchant payables owed to operators were 396.8; 219.4 of cash is held outside the U.S. The roughly 741.0 sale proceeds arrived November 1, 2026 and are excluded. Revolver matures June 29, 2028.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Ratios rest on management Adjusted EBITDA, and the credit agreement, covenant ratio and sale agreements are not supplied, so creditor protections are untested.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a management non-GAAP measure, the annual continuing base rests on a release, and neither the covenant ratio nor the credit agreement is supplied.
